They can be trained at the Barracks and also at Donjons by the Sicilians. They are an excellent cavalry-counter, but are weak against anything outside the cavalry section, particularly archers, though they make up for it by being one of the cheapest military units in the game.

t: Pikeman Armor for an Officer | The Art Institute of Chicago
s: English Pikemen were infantrymen (foot soldiers) so named for their principal weapon, the pike, a staff that measured 16 to 20 feet in length. Abundantly studded with steel brass-capped rivets within embossed V-shaped motifs, a pikeman’s armor included a helmet (pott), cuirass (breastplate and backplate), gorget (collar), and tassets (riveted steel skirt plates attached to the breastplate).
